key_insight: STARE fixes policy entropy collapse in RL for LLM reasoning by reweighting token-level advantages using surprisal-based entropy-critical token selection and a target-entropy feedback gate.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical training control method for stabilizing post-training RL across model scales and long reasoning/tool-use workloads, improving reliability and accuracy.
method: Identify entropy-critical tokens via batch-internal surprisal quantiles.
Reweight their effective advantages to reduce token-level credit assignment mismatch.
Use a closed-loop target-entropy gate to keep policy entropy within a stable band.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports stable training over thousands of steps across 1.5B–32B models and three task families, with 4%–8% accuracy gains on AIME24 and AIME25 over DAPO and other baselines.
watch_item: The method depends on accurate surprisal/entropy estimation and quantile-based gating, so threshold tuning and batch composition may affect stability and transfer across tasks.
paper_title: STARE: Surprisal-Guided Token-Level Advantage Reweighting for Policy Entropy Stability
